# What the live suite has passed

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/live/suite.mjs table` from docs/live/records/. Do not edit it by hand. -->

Each cell is the latest record of a check on one backend and surface, shown only when it passed. A dash is a
check that has not passed there: not run yet, or failed in its latest run. [scripts/live/](../../scripts/live/)
holds the checks; the records below name the builds.

## Terminal

| Check | Codex | Grok Build | ZCode | Kimi Code |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| Stop a running job with TaskStop | cancelled in 1.3 s | cancelled in 1.1 s | cancelled in 1.1 s | cancelled in 1.4 s |

| Stop a running job with TaskStop | cancelled in 0.8 s | cancelled in 1.0 s | cancelled in 1.1 s | cancelled in 0.8 s |

## How each backend took a message

- **Into the running turn**: Codex, Grok Build, ZCode. The backend added the message to the turn it was running.
- **As the next turn**: Kimi Code. The message reached the job as fast, waited for the running turn to end, and then ran as a turn of its own.
- **A new turn of the job**: Codex, Grok Build, ZCode, Kimi Code. A message sent after the job ended ran as a new turn.
